svg.title: Mandelbrot exterior proof: exact six-iterate center obstruction
svg.desc: Nine parent squares split into 16 children: 102 previous certified whole squares, 20 unresolved squares whose centers escape by the sixth iterate, and 22 unresolved squares whose centers do not escape by the sixth iterate.

g.text: Exact centers in 42 unfinished Mandelbrot parameter squares
102 whole squares certified in earlier work
A limit of the method, not a membership claim
A gold cell contains a center with |z₆(c)| < 2, so a uniform six-step escape proof fails there.
Blue certifies only its center. Neither blue nor gold implies Mandelbrot membership. Im(δ) increases upward.
